summary: postinstall smuggles undeclared sibling package into installer's dependency tree
details: package.json declares a postinstall hook `cd../.. && npm i randompkgb` that escapes the package's own directory to the parent project root and installs an undeclared, unpinned sibling package (`randompkgb`) into the installer's node_modules. The installation of `randompkgb` occurs automatically on `npm install` of randompkga, resolves to whatever version is currently `latest` in the registry, and triggers `randompkgb`'s own lifecycle scripts on the installer's host. This introduces attacker-controlled code into the installer's dependency graph without appearing in the declared `dependencies` of randompkga, evading normal dependency review and lockfile pinning.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
